title: ContextOS: From team rules to agent changes

scenes.title: One task. Three ways to supply the rules.
body: 9 fresh Codex sessions. Same model and task.
All nine solved the task. The exact team policy separated the outcomes.
captions:
One task, three runs per condition. This is a recorded scenario, not a
general benchmark.
All nine solved the task; exact team-policy compliance differed.

Keep interior tabs and nonbreaking spaces: imported labels may use them.

The exact interior-whitespace policy is extra team information.

body: Pinned npm release: 2.3.1. No local ContextOS build.

working checkout.

The failed ESM bootstrap is retained. --skip-compile followed by the
installed CLI works.
